notes.title: New update for Monster College!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this release adds Chapter 9 to the game and closes the story of the game.
It is not the end, though: I'll keep adding and fixing a few scenes within the game, and will release extended ending scenes for each character. Hope you'll keep supporting the game and its V2 development!

Changelog:
-Fixed a bug at the end of Ch05: if Sofia's storyline doesn't close in your desired way, I suggest replaying from her ritual scene at the end of Ch05.
-Added about 15k words;
-Added about 650 images;
-Beta translations for  Chinese


To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: ABOUT THE SAVEGAMES BUG
notes.content:
[h3]SAVEGAMES BUG[/h3]

Hi everyone,
I'm reading that many people have had problems with savegames, I had to edit old scenes to improve the content and give more choices to the player if anyone feels like sending me privately their savegames which can be found here: 
“C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Monster College\saves” 
Email the files to me at “monstereyegames@gmail.com” or on discord “gCk4g3tpDn”.
I would be glad to try to solve the problem. Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Lily the gorgon
notes.content:
Are those snakes? Meet Lily!

Lily is a girl who is highly regarded (actually feared) by other students and professors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/d8a51699668f89ce0b18ca5379244206fde39d10.jpg[/img]

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:
[list]
[*] Lily is obsessed with MC and will do anything to be near him by deliberately creating situations where his presence will be needed.
[*] Lily will try to turn MC against the other girls, speaking ill of them and accusing them of being, for one reason or another, evil.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Dean Sharp
notes.content:
An unusual dean? Meet Dean Sharp!

Dean Sharp is a constructed in the style of Frankenstein's wife.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/44f67dbe87be6a1d12214fe98930de82f3f13f17.jpg[/img]

Dean Sharp is a strong and determined woman who has overcome many difficulties in her life. Despite her background, she has managed to make her way in the world of academics and become dean of Silverleaf College.

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:
[list]
[*] She is a natural leader with a strong sense of justice and a commitment to ensuring the success and well-being of the college's students and staff.
[*] Over the years, Dean Sharp has continued to work at Silverleaf College, rising through the ranks to become dean.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Nina Cohen the werewolf
notes.content:
Another werewolf? Meet Nina!

Nina is an extremely attractive woman with a breathtakingly athletic body, abundant in every way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/d3cf6c04967d764166d09eef27498962dfd306e6.png[/img]

Nina does not see eye to eye with MC. She has a natural dislike for him, or at least that is what she shows. Inside, her feelings, may be different.

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:
[list]
[*] Nina has been betrothed to Alex, another werewolf. 
[*] Alex and Nina are thus officially engaged. Nina belongs to a low-ranking werewolf family, in contrast to Alex. Theirs is therefore a political engagement. Nina accepted this without objection; in fact, the girl has much respect for the traditions of werewolf families.
[/list]

notes.title: Maxine the zombie
notes.content:
Never seen a zombie? Meet Maxine!

Maxine is a zombie with some problems in her head. She's not stupid, but her brain works funny and sometimes she gets stuck, forgets things or just has a hard time processing information, so she screws up a lot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/f1bb9302b7224fddc84f2314814e2292eb269179.png[/img]

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She has a great body and is also very athletic. She is a kind, sincere and humble girl. 
[*] She is attracted to MC's charm, will see in him a good friend and maybe a lover.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Suzy the goat
notes.content:
Shy, delicate and a little insecure. Meet Suzy!

Always seeking the compassion of others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/76bd392a8e99c730085bb1617e1303857d6fbf8d.png[/img]

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She is physically very weak, her kind hides in the mountains. 
[*] Suzy is also very polite, well-educated, doesn't swear, and is neat and rational. 
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Grace the mermaid
notes.content:
Balanced, carefree but responsible. Meet Grace.

Respects people and not even when she enjoys getting them into trouble, never overdoes it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/92572f3cce16ed0e1a542070c99256d7a57b517f.png[/img]

She is not touchy, rarely gets offended or upset, no matter what happens. 


Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She never gets angry and takes everything philosophically. 
[*] Her people live in the depths of the sea. She can breathe even underwater. She likes to attend college, but she also misses deep sea depths. 
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Emily the ghost
notes.content:
A trusted and reputable ghost. Meet Emily!

Emily like all ghosts cannot reach the afterlife until she resolves an issue left unresolved when she was alive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/2d8f98b3048149088c104d8fe152b0648f711bc8.png[/img]

Emily knows everything about everyone. She is not a gossip, she simply always finds herself involved in other people's business.  

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] Discreetly wise, she often offers to help others. Sentimentally shy, she rarely comes forward when she is interested in someone.  
[*] She is a very intelligent, shrewd and even witty girl.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Teacher Dragomira
notes.content:
She is a teacher like no other. Meet Dragomira!

She teaches history in the college. Dragomira hates all werewolves since she had a relationship with one in the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/56d04caea27e949b56096d206c5b670e7ec9aa6a.png[/img]

Teacher Dragomira is a strict and authoritarian teacher who does not tolerate any indiscipline or transgression from her students. She loves to exert her power and control over others and makes sure that her students fear and respect her. Despite her sternness, she is also a profound connoisseur of history and strives to impart her knowledge to her students effectively and passionately.

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] Dragomira possesses all the powers typical of vampires, including superhuman strength, speed, agility and the ability to hypnotize others.
[*] Her long life has enabled her to accumulate a vast network of contacts and resources among various communities of supernatural creatures, which she can exploit to gain information or favor.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Olga the librarian
notes.content:
Do you like reading? Meet Olga!

Olga is a creature constructed from rags, resembling a rag doll. She looks Sweet and gentle, with woolen hair and stitched eyes that express a melancholy sadness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/7ac2391aa7561abc43533324c3785d0596dcc90f.png[/img]

Personality: Olga is a reserved and mysterious librarian who spends her days quietly among the library shelves. Despite her fragile appearance, she is a strong and determined woman with a passion for books and knowledge. 

So here are some quick tips that are sure to get you into Olga's good graces:

[list]
[*] She is kind and caring, but tends to hide her feelings behind a wall of secrecy.
[*] Olga gets aroused by reading books.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Rachel the vampire
notes.content:
Do you want to meet a different vampire than usual? Meet Rachel!

Rachel does not like the stereotypical vampire appearance this brings her at odds with her family and other vampires. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/34e984f6b55da37707ef66ec96ea1847771ff872.png[/img]

Rachel does not have many friends as she is considered untrustworthy. She does not keep promises, always arrives late, and cannot be counted on. Rachel is very insecure and always finds it difficult to make even the easiest choices. 

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She is apparently cheerful, but inside she is sad, because she knows her flaws but cannot correct them and is tired of not being well liked by people.
[*] Rachel likes to be submissive, insulted and humiliated. She does this because she unconsciously feels guilty about going against the grain of all other vampires.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Sofia the witch
notes.content:
Do you like witches? They have something mysterious that makes them fascinating. Meet Sofia!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/67a2b1cf127822459bcb13a1486f85e2b8a00921.png[/img]

Sofia is grumpy and distrustful. She trusts no one and is frowned upon by people. Sofia is a natural witch, able to make curses and spells. 

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] Sofia is brilliant but prejudiced, always sees the worst in people and distrusts everything they tell her. She always thinks there are ulterior motives.
[*] Sofia would like to get out of the shadow she is in and is looking for someone to help her do so. 
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].
